provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: An initially empty connected network is invaded quasistatically from reservoir. Each cylindrical throat opens only at pressure P>=-2*gamma*cos(theta)/r. A pore body becomes accessible only when some complete reservoir path has ALL its throat thresholds satisfied. All supplied body radii exceed adjacent throat radii, so no additional body-entry barrier is imposed. Once accessible, its entire spherical body volume4*pi*r_body^3/3 is counted; ignore throat volumes, trapping, snap-off, compressibility and hysteresis.
protocol: Find the first access pressure for every body using the complete network, including alternate paths. Intruded fraction is accessible body volume divided by the volume of all four bodies, not a count of reached pores.
scope: Controlled capillary-access model. The inverse of a first-access pressure reflects a bottleneck of a reservoir path, and is not generally the radius of the newly accessed pore body.
